gaps.explanation: p7 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position - Proprietary Funds prints enterprise columns Landfill Fund / Electric Fund / Combined System Utilities Fund (Internal Service Funds column excluded; the only combining schedules, pp21-22, are internal service). No business-type lines in detail[]. JSON receipts = Sales 89,779,000 + Other revenue 19,044 + Interest income 307,444 + Participation and capacity agreements 665,627 + Net coal sales 1,803,612 + Miscellaneous income 856,306 + Loss on disposal of capital assets (24,015) = 93,407,018. Added per column, same rows: Landfill 2,572,974 + 19,044 + 32,141 - 24,015 = 2,600,144; Electric 62,662,440 + 197,084 + 665,627 + 1,803,612 + 566,240 = 65,895,003; Combined System Utilities 24,543,586 + 78,219 + 290,066 = 24,911,871; sum 93,407,018 = statement (gap 0). The Landfill loss (24,015) is printed negative in the nonoperating section and added as printed, like the statement line.
